nodes.title: Short-time current cases

nodes.title: Chosen gauges
nodes.text: AWG for [ESC power lead, ESC alternative checked]; the main jumper gauge is P:power.jumper_awg (10 AWG, PWR-R1). D-74: no UBEC feed or servo bus wire (the servo rail is the FC Vx header)

nodes.title: Short bundled ESC-lead sections (F2 routing, CR-F2-02)
nodes.text: [name, length m, cooling factor] for sections where more than one pair shares a passage
nodes.basis: F2: LR/LL pairs together through the P1 straw (~0.05 m) and two twisted pairs stacked 8 mm in the pod crossing (~0.09 m). Factor = fraction of free-air convection + radiation kept: straw enclosed in foam 0.3 (four conductors, little radiation out), pod crossing 0.6 (twisted 0.85 x stacked ~0.7). Judgement, conservative; T-F1-WIRE-HEAT checks the straw

nodes.title: Silicone wire outside diameter by gauge
nodes.text: [AWG, OD mm] for high-strand silicone hobby wire
nodes.basis: typical maker tables (BNTECHGO, Turnigy) +/-0.2 mm; measure the reel

nodes.title: Cooling derates
nodes.text: [f_pod, f_channel, f_pair, emissivity]: f_pod 1.0 in the vented pod (still air); f_channel 0.75 for a lead in a tape-covered surface groove in the wing; f_pair 0.85 for a twisted +/- pair (pod only; in the wing + and - lie in two grooves 5 mm apart, f 1.0); silicone emissivity 0.9
nodes.basis: engineering judgement: a covered groove halves convection but keeps radiation to the tape and foam (~0.75 overall); a twisted pair shields ~15 % of each conductor's surface. Prop wash over the wing in hover is not credited. T-F1-WIRE-HEAT measures it

nodes.title: Contact resistance per mated contact
nodes.text: AS150U contact 0.8 mOhm (two in the path)
nodes.basis: reseller values 0.40 and <= 0.8 mOhm; the larger is used

nodes.title: Current shunt, board copper and solder joints
nodes.text: 0.6 mOhm in the common path (sensor shunt ~0.25, copper and four solder joints ~0.35)
nodes.basis: typical 0.2-0.3 mOhm hobby PDB shunts; measured by T-F1-DROP

nodes.title: Servo stall current 1.4 A at 6 V
nodes.text: per elevon servo, Savox SH-0255MG+ (D6), rated 4.8-6.0 V (not HV)
nodes.basis: D6 CR-D6-06: retailer data 1.2 A at 4.8 V / 1.4 A at 6.0 V (was 1.3 A class value); measured by T-F1-SERVO-STALL on the delivered servos

nodes.title: Current-sensor tolerance 5 %
nodes.basis: requirement value; the 100 A limiter acts on the sensed current

nodes.title: XT30U in each ESC branch (D-74, WB-03)
nodes.text: one mated XT30U pair per ESC branch at the pod side exit: 2 contacts x 1.2 mOhm in the branch loop
nodes.basis: Amass maximum contact resistance (harness SPEC.md); T-F1-DROP measures the branch with the plugs in

nodes.title: Board-to-board link (W-PMOD, case S): 28 AWG conductors per role
nodes.text: [FC-BEC 5 V, SERVO-BEC Vx, GND] conductors in parallel; BATT_VOLT and BATT_CURR one each (10 wired). Vx gets 4 (all four SERVO-BEC contacts) so the servo terminal voltage holds 5.7 V (F2 CL-F2-SERVO-V)
nodes.basis: CoreWing manual PDB pin figure (power SPEC.md: FC-BEC x several, SERVO-BEC x 4, GND x several); 10 of them so the folded ribbon fits D2's 10 mm under-pack channel beside the RX and airspeed leads (F2 CL-F2-FILL); pin map measured at BOARD-CHECK.md step 4

nodes.title: Bus capacitance per ESC 1 000 uF
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A input capacitor plus the added low-ESR 680 uF at each ESC (0.5 m leads)
nodes.basis: leads beyond ~0.15 m need added capacitance at the ESC; value = ripple practice, checked by T-F1-RIPPLE

nodes.title: Pessimistic mission current profile from E2's phase claims
nodes.equation: table [phase, t_phase, I_phase] in flight order (ground, climb, hover, transition forward, cruise, back-transition, descent)

nodes.title: Design currents for the pack path
nodes.equation: I_cont = max(I_hover, I_cruise, P_vclimb / V_nom) ; I_short = max profile phase <= 60 s ; I_req = k I

nodes.title: Wire derating: steady rise, mission-profile peak, drop, mass
nodes.equation: see module docstring; ESC lead current = I_pack / n x 2s/(1+s) (heavier pair at the hover split s, applied to every branch); R_ext = R_common + 1/sum(1/R_branch_i); drop = I R_common + I_esc R_branch,max

nodes.title: Pack's own leads: gauge and length after re-termination
nodes.text: [assumed maker gauge AWG, alternative gauge AWG, length one way m]
nodes.basis: the Ovonic listing does not give the lead gauge (open the product sheet / measure); 4S 6500 130C packs ship with 10 or 12 AWG. Length: D2 CR-D2-07 needs >= 90 mm from the pack aft face to the parked connector; cut to 0.10 m when the AS150U is fitted

nodes.title: Pack's own leads: steady and mission-peak rise
nodes.equation: same wire model as CALC-F1-WIRES, pod still air, side-by-side pair (f_pair)

nodes.equation: tau = R_pre x n x C_esc ; 3 tau to 95 % ; I_inrush = V_full / R_pre

nodes.how: T-F1-SERVO-STALL: meter in the 5 V lines of the link while the FC, GPS, RX and airspeed run.

nodes.how: T-F1-SERVO-STALL: both servos stalled 60 s, touch-probe the ribbon; Vx >= 5.8 V at the servo header.
nodes.note: D-74: the servo BEC on the power board reaches the FC Vx rail through the board-to-board link (case S: SERVO-BEC conductors in parallel; case U: the stacked pin header, no cable). Supersedes CR-F1-29.

nodes.title: Power-board link GND conductors, steady rise at 5 V load + servo stall
nodes.how: Same bench run as CL-F1-PMOD-SERVO-RISE.

nodes.title: Wire heat runs
nodes.procedure: Bench supply (>= 40 A) + load; built power stack (10 AWG jumpers) in a closed pod mock-up at 30 A, 16 AWG pair in a taped XPS groove at 8.4 A, two pairs through a 50 mm straw at 8.4 A each, each 10 min; K-type thermocouples mid-lead under foam tape; then 50 A for 2 s on the 16 AWG. Pass: rise <= 10 degC steady (jumpers: above their joints), <= 30 degC peak, pack leads <= 20 degC.

nodes.title: AS150U heat run
nodes.procedure: 38 A for 10 min through a mated pair; IR thermometer on the housing; rise <= 30 degC.

nodes.title: Path resistance
nodes.procedure: 20 A load step from the pack; meter across pack terminals and across one ESC's pads; R = dV/dI. Pass: drop <= 2 % at 30 A.

nodes.title: Current sensor calibration
nodes.procedure: Clamp meter on the main lead at 5, 15, 25, 30 A (motors on the restrained frame); set BATT_AMP_PERVLT so BAT.Curr is within 5 %; record the value for F4.

nodes.title: Servo stall current and rail voltage
nodes.procedure: Each servo blocked at full deflection 2 s on the power-board servo BEC (6 V jumper), meter in series; both together: Vx >= 5.8 V at the servo and FC 5 V rail >= 4.8 V (as BOARD-CHECK.md step 7, with the real servos).

nodes.title: Anti-spark behaviour
nodes.procedure: Scope on the bus while plugging the AS150U slowly; bus >= 95 % before the main pins close; no spark marks after 20 plug cycles.

nodes.title: ESC supply ripple
nodes.procedure: Scope at each ESC's pads, full-throttle 2 s punch on the stand: ripple <= 1.0 V p-p, no spikes above 21 V (ESC caps 25 V).
